name: ETL MoEngage Data Export to Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **MoEngage Data Export** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your S3 Bucket using the **(+)** icon with your **Access Key, Secret Key, Bucket Name & AWS Location.**
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/moengage-dataexport/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
